record.name: Big-Game Hunter
record.description: Big-Game Hunters are masters of tracking and hunting dangerous creatures, using their skills to track, trap, and defeat the most formidable beasts in the galaxy.

subclass_identity_profile.core_fantasy: Fearless trackers of the galaxy's most ferocious beasts.

progression_tree.description: You gain proficiency in Survival and Nature. Your Dexterity modifier is added to your initiative rolls.
You learn to use the environment to your advantage. You can hide in areas with difficult terrain, even when you're not hiding.
You learn to track and predict the movements of your prey. You can use your Wisdom (Perception) score instead of your Dexterity score for stealth checks.
You learn to set up traps and ambushes. You can use your proficiency in Athletics or Acrobatics to set up a trap, which deals damage to creatures that trigger it.

effects.value: Athletics or Acrobatics for trap setting

progression_tree.description: You gain expertise in two skills of your choice. You can use this expertise to make skill checks related to tracking and hunting.

dynamic_visuals.combat_stance: Assumes a stance of balance and agility, with knees slightly bent and weight evenly distributed between both feet.
dynamic_visuals.energy_signature: Emits a distinctive aura of concentrated force energy surrounding the user's lightsaber, pulsating with a soothing blue-white light.

prompt_schema.base_prompt: A fearless galaxy tracker standing heroically amidst a swirling vortex of debris, their trusty blaster at the ready to face whatever dangers lie ahead.
contextual_modifiers: In a dimly lit, abandoned temple on the forest moon of Endor
With a pack of loyal, genetically engineered hunting beasts by their side
